$comment: Source for the generated manual review index. The record of truth for outcomes stays docs/releases/0.17-manual-a11y.md; scripts/consumer/manual-review.mjs --check fails if the two disagree on ids or pages. Expectations are copied from that matrix, not invented here.

scenarios.title: Dialog
scenarios.keys: Enter or Space on the button; Tab / Shift+Tab inside; Escape
scenarios.expectedFocus: Moves into the dialog and stays inside it; on close returns to "Open dialog"
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: A dialog named "Pick a fruit" with its description; the background is not reachable

scenarios.title: Drawer
scenarios.keys: Enter or Space on the button; Escape
scenarios.expectedFocus: Moves into the drawer; Escape closes it and focus returns to the opener

scenarios.title: Select
scenarios.keys: Enter to open; Up/Down arrows; Enter to choose
scenarios.expectedFocus: Trigger keeps focus; the active option follows the arrows; after choosing, focus is on the trigger
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: Button with a listbox popup and expanded state; each option with selected state and position; the chosen value

scenarios.title: Menu
scenarios.keys: Enter to open; Up/Down arrows; Enter to choose
scenarios.expectedFocus: Moves to the first item; selection closes the menu and focus returns to the trigger
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: A menu with item names and positions

scenarios.title: Combobox
scenarios.expectedFocus: DOM focus stays in the input; the active option is exposed through aria-activedescendant
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: A combobox; options announced as they become active; the filtered count is perceivable; the value
scenarios.reviewTarget: Result-count announcement is a suspected gap, not a confirmed defect. Record exactly what is (or is not) announced after typing.

scenarios.title: FormField
scenarios.keys: Enter on the submit button; Tab between fields
scenarios.expectedFocus: Natural Tab order; no focus trap
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: Each field with label, hint, "invalid" and its error (the error is role=alert and announced once on appearing); required state
scenarios.reviewTarget: Validation feedback: confirm each error is announced once, not repeated.

scenarios.title: FormField (async validation, Checkbox, Switch)
steps: Move to the Checkbox and Switch
scenarios.expectedFocus: Focus is not moved by validation
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: Pending validation is not announced noisily; the "taken" error is announced; Checkbox and Switch with label, hint and state

scenarios.title: Sidebar
scenarios.keys: Enter on the toggle; Tab through items; Escape on the off-canvas sidebar
steps: Narrow the window to phone width
Open and close the off-canvas sidebar
scenarios.expectedFocus: Off-canvas sidebar is entered with focus inside; Escape returns focus to "Toggle sidebar"
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: Rail items by name; collapsed versus closed is distinguishable

scenarios.title: NavigationMenu
scenarios.keys: Enter; Tab into the revealed link; Escape
scenarios.expectedFocus: Revealed link is reachable; Escape collapses and returns focus to "Products"

scenarios.title: Toast
scenarios.keys: Enter on the button; Tab to "Undo"
scenarios.expectedFocus: Focus is not moved by the toast; "Undo" is reachable; dismissal does not strand focus
scenarios.reviewTarget: Toast live-region behaviour is unverified. Record whether it is announced, and how many times.

scenarios.title: Resizable
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: A separator with orientation, name and value; value changes are announced

scenarios.title: InputOTP
steps: On a device, use the OS one-time-code suggestion
scenarios.expectedFocus: Focus stays in the single text field
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: One text field "Verification code"; slot digits not read as separate controls; completion perceivable
scenarios.reviewTarget: Also covers physical IME and OS clipboard paste in Firefox/WebKit.

scenarios.title: FileUpload
scenarios.keys: Tab to "Browse"; Enter; choose a file in the OS dialog
scenarios.expectedFocus: Returns to the page after the OS dialog without being stranded
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: Button and input named; the chosen file name perceivable; the dropzone is not the only way in

scenarios.title: Autofill
steps: Follow the Autofill verification procedure with a throwaway browser profile and synthetic data
Trigger the browser's autofill into a field
scenarios.expectedFocus: Autofill does not move focus by itself
scenarios.expectedAnnouncement: No duplicate announcements; data-autofilled appears, the Forms value updates; record which engines emit an observable event
